transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. I guess... well, I've just been having some trouble staying in my chair lately. 

Like, during sprint planning at work, or... even important things, like a mortgage call I had recently. I just keep getting up. Even when I know I really need to stay put, I'll just... I don't know, suddenly decide I need to get water, or I'll go check on something in the other room. 

It's just been happening a lot, so... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you feel anxious or nervous when you're in those situations where you have trouble staying seated?

Um... no. Not really. 

I don't... I'm not anxious about the meetings or anything. I just... I don't know, I just get up.
Do you feel like you're getting up for a specific reason, or is it more of a sudden urge to move?

I guess... it's more like an urge. 

Even if I'm, you know, just sitting there looking fine, I just... I feel this pressure inside. Like I have to move. Or switch to something else, or... just do something with my hands. It just feels like I'm going to crawl out of my skin if I don't.
Do you have trouble focusing on tasks or activities outside of these situations where you have trouble staying seated?

I suppose so. Um... like if I'm reviewing a pull request at work. Or looking at those mortgage documents. 

I'll sit down meaning to read them, but... after a few minutes, I just realize I'm staring at the exact same section. And my mind is just on... I don't know, a bunch of unrelated things instead. So... yeah. I guess I do.
Did you have trouble sitting still or paying attention when you were a kid?

Yeah... I suppose so. 

Um, in elementary school, I remember my teachers having to move my desk sometimes. Or they'd have to remind me to stay seated. I guess I was always... popping up. And I'd talk before I was called on, or... just rush through my work, even when I understood it fine. 

So... yeah.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
I don't really know. Um... I don't think so. I mean, I guess sometimes I might do things without planning them out completely, but... I haven't really noticed it being a big problem.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety when you're not in a situation where you need to sit still?

I suppose so. Um... even if I look like I'm just sitting there calmly, I usually feel... I don't know, this sort of pressure inside. Like I need to be moving, or switching what I'm doing. Or at least doing something with my hands... otherwise I feel like I'm going to crawl out of my skin. So, yeah. I guess I do feel restless a lot.
As a kid, did you often climb on things or run excessively?

Um... not really? I don't think so. I mean, I played outside like anyone else, but... I don't remember constantly climbing on things or running around when I wasn't supposed to. So... no, probably not.
Do you often interrupt others when they're speaking?
I don't believe so. Um... I usually just wait for them to finish. I mean, nobody has ever really complained to me about it, so... no, I don't think I do.
Do you often have trouble organizing your tasks or activities?

I suppose. Um... things just kind of end up everywhere. Like my work tickets, or... notes for fixing things around the house, budget reminders. They just get scattered. Between Slack, sticky notes, my email, my phone... I don't know. I guess I spend more time trying to figure out what I'm supposed to do than actually getting it done. So... yeah.
Did you often have trouble following through on instructions or finishing your homework when you were in school?

I don't really remember much about school, to be honest. But... I guess I do struggle with instructions sometimes now. 

Um... like, if my husband asks me to call the insurance company, upload a form, and then email the confirmation... I usually do the first part. But somehow the last step just... sits unfinished. Until he reminds me about it. So... yeah, I suppose so.
Do you often talk excessively?
Not really. Um... I usually keep to myself, mostly. At work, I'm usually just looking at my screens and coding, so... no, I wouldn't say that.
Have you experienced these feelings of restlessness and trouble staying seated for most of your life?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I mean, I don't remember a lot, but... I do remember teachers in elementary school having to move my desk. Or, you know, constantly telling me to sit down. I was always popping out of my seat, or blurting things out before it was my turn. And I'd just rush through my work, even when I knew how to do it. So... yeah, it's been a while.
Do you ever find yourself becoming so focused on a task or activity that you lose track of time and forget about everything else?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I do that. I mean, I do my work, but... I usually know what time it is. So, no.
Do you ever become so absorbed in an activity that you forget about everything else around you?
Um... I think you just asked me that, actually. But... no. I don't really get absorbed like that. I usually stay pretty aware of what's going on around me.
Have these difficulties with sitting still, focusing, and following through on tasks caused any significant problems for you at work or in your personal relationships?

Um... I guess it's been causing some issues lately. At work, and... at home, too. It just seems like people are having to follow up with me a lot more than they used to. I don't really like it. I just... I worry that people are starting to think I'm unreliable, especially when it comes to planning things. Even though I'm really trying. So... yeah, there's been some friction.
Have your difficulties with sitting still, focusing, and following through on tasks caused problems in your friendships or relationships with family members?

Um... I think that's kind of what I just meant. When I said there was friction at home. But... as for my friends? No, not really. I don't think it's affected them. It's mostly just... what I already told you.
Did your parents or teachers ever comment on your behavior or difficulties when you were a kid, suggesting that you had problems with attention or hyperactivity?

Um... I mean, a little bit, yeah. Mostly back in elementary school. I remember... teachers would move my desk sometimes. Or they'd have to keep reminding me to just stay in my seat. I guess I was always popping up, or... talking before they called on me. And I'd rush through things a lot, even when I actually understood the work. But... yeah. That's about it, really.
Have your difficulties with sitting still, focusing, and following through on tasks caused problems in your romantic relationship?
Um... no. Not really. I haven't noticed any issues there. My partner hasn't said anything about it, so... yeah. It's fine.
